scope: Controlled wider residual policy-decoder study following completed repeated neural stalls. Supervised expert-replay pretraining, not current-model self-play RL or a new AlphaZero/Leela algorithm.
hypothesis: Replacing a large location-specific dense classifier with shared relative-displacement logits may improve data efficiency and actual-clock policy/value planning. Fewer parameters, lower CE or an exact action map alone cannot establish strength.
initialization: One common cold seed; all shared trunk, value and policy-conv/BN arrays must match exactly, and initial value outputs match on64TRAIN rows. Decoder functions differ by design; this is not full-function-preserving widening of the old warm model.
relative_decoder: 32shared policy features ->50relative-displacement planes by1x1convolution, gather only the original2550geometric actions before softmax. Same actual movement/legality mask and observer contract. This shares a decoder; it does not assume palace/river/dark-home game translation symmetry.
data: Exactly the original4certified native replay files:32768generated games,32767with searched records,2417541positions. Same512selection games/37471positions. Original certified zero-search-prefix game preserved; no invented action or game-boundary merge.
targets: Original one-hot actual teacher-selected move and0.7*tanh(score/860)+0.3terminal outcome, actor perspective; same in both arms. Keep original input encoder and public-only inventory canonicalization; no true hidden identities or fabricated history planes.

training.schedule: 5% linear warmup then cosine to10% peak
training.augmentation: Original horizontal mirror, same dedicated per-arm RNG stream
training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum common selection CE+MSE within each complete12-epoch run; initial excluded. No early stop, retuning or match-based model choice.
training.precision: Original BF16autocast if supported, otherwise scaled FP16; finite gradients required, no skipped updates counted.

resources: Two independent single-GPU training arms with2CPU threads each, separate from live match GPUs. This is not distributed training, equal FLOP/memory cost or multi-training-seed robustness. Matched data/updates, architecture changes parameter count and runtime.
match_conditions: Actual10+0.1, LeafBatch32neural actors, one CPU thread each,2concurrent games on one dedicated shared inference GPU per campaign. Dense/relative use the same tagged safe loader and unchanged observer/search. Measure actual throughput; no equal-work/Hash/simulation claim.
outcome_dependence: Finish all5contrasts regardless of earlier results; freeze selected artifacts before first game. No head/budget/label tuning on matches. Raw native identity/legality/terminal/clock audits required, with technical/ambiguous flags retained. No promotion from a degraded control or geometry tests; final independent multi-set70%strong-suite/report gate remains unmet.
